biotools.summary: The Vaginal Microbial Genome Collection (VMGC) is a resource comprising 33,804 microbial genomes spanning bacteria, viruses, and fungi from the human vaginal microbiome. It provides a valuable resource for studying vaginal microbiota and its impact on vaginal health.
